critical_code_review_comments: procurement.py:353-361 (patch_co) computes revised_amount in two steps — first ad-hoc sum then recompute via committed_amount. The intermediate write is dead (immediately overwritten). Simplify to a single committed_amount recomputation after setattr to reduce cognitive load and avoid a subtle race where a caller reads mid-transaction.

procurement.py:604-610 (client_proc_docs) fetches ALL is_client_visible docs across the DB then filters in Python by matching related_id against the project's PO/Sub/BP id lists. For a system with many projects this is O(all_visible_docs). Prefer a single JOIN or use SQL IN(...) on (related_type, related_id) tuple filters.

vendors.py:41 search filter uses ILIKE on name only. Consider also including trade/contact_name if the UI search box is meant to be broader — currently frontend behaviour not verified against this, but worth documenting.

Award endpoint (procurement.py:147-170) uses ADMIN role but does NOT check vendor insurance before creating the draft PO/Subcontract from an awarded bid. The insurance gate only fires at /approve time, which is acceptable but could be surfaced earlier as a warning in the response.

Bid submit endpoint (procurement.py:115) does not validate that the vendor is actually invited to the bid package — a vendor with no invitation can submit a bid; the invitation flip logic (line 124) silently no-ops. Consider 422 if invitation missing, or auto-create the invitation.

LineItemTable canWrite is gated on pa.status==Draft — after Submit, no way to add more line items. This matches typical AIA G702/G703 semantics (freeze on submit) but is worth documenting as intentional; the UI hides the Add button which is why my UI test noted 'line-item-add not visible' after the pay app moved past Draft.

Overview cells on CommitmentDetailPage: label 'Retainage' is not present in the DOM text on the subcontract 2 overview I inspected — spec asked for 'retainage %' visible in Overview cells. Confirm the label wording in the UI matches (may be 'Retention %' or shown only when >0). Insurance was present.
